1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The README is prose answering to prose: the whole file — the verb list and the quick-start examples alike — is read through for claims that contradict the product, the help surface, or the release's install routes it points at; a verb-list-only read is what missed a quick-start example that handed an argument to a no-argument verb. Its six edges span three cells — two prose parents (natural→natural), three requirement-sentence parents (structured→natural) and one artifact parent (code→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
